item: The time slider no longer covers the Signals button that turns it off (row 162)
summary: With the Signals layer on, the time slider sat at a fixed 36 px above the map edge on the same layer as the layer buttons; once they wrapped to a second row it covered them, and at 1280 px the Signals button could not be clicked, so the layer could be turned on but not off. Buttons and slider now share one bottom stack (column growing upward, empty part pointer-events none); measured in Chromium at 1280, 760 and 640 px, the button takes the click at each.
